page.overview:
Who is Antonio Leontaris?

Wave Lord Antonio Leontaris is the High Priest of Mathann in the Tilean city-state of Miragliano.

He's a hardened naval commander. His craggy, unsmiling face is testament to his many years in spiritual and physical conflict with the pirates of Sartosa and Araby. He has appointed a crew of captains to research the Skaven navies of Clan Skurvy and Clan Skuttle.
